<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The .SRCINFO file defines the package metadata for `caveman-bin`, a binary package distributed via the AUR. It lists multiple sources, all of which are fetched from the official GitHub repository (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) or the public npm registry, which aligns with the project's stated upstream. The sources include prebuilt binaries for x86_64 and aarch64, as well as license and notice files, which is typical for a `-bin` package that bundles compiled assets.

All sources are accompanied by matching `sha256sums`, ensuring integrity verification. There are no signs of obfuscated URLs, suspicious network operations, or dynamically fetched executable content during build or install phases (though the PKGBUILD would contain those details; this file only reflects metadata). The package depends on `nodejs>=22.13`, which is reasonable for a Node.js-based CLI tool, and optionally uses `chromium` for headless browsing—both expected and non-malicious.

No dangerous operations such as data exfiltration, use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, or runtime downloads are indicated in this file. The licensing is multi-licensed under common open-source terms, and the inclusion of third-party license files further suggests compliance efforts. Overall, the package follows standard AUR packaging practices for a binary distribution.
</details>
